description: Set a savings goal and instantly discover how much to invest monthly, how long it will take, or what return rate you need to get there — all in one smart calculator. Choose from Conservative, Moderate, or Aggressive strategies and watch an interactive chart project your wealth up to 50 years into the future. See a clear breakdown of your starting balance, total contributions, and interest earned at a glance. This app is suitable for all ages.

defaultPrompt: How much do I need to save to reach $1,000,000?
